questions.q: 5FU + leucovorin generate ____ , which blocks thymidylate synthase in the ternary complex.
questions.exp: 5Fu + leucovorin → fdump; ternary complex fdump-T.S (Book p286)

questions.q: T.S. stands for ____ synthase.
dUMP is ____ monophosphate.
TMP is ____ monophosphate.
Antifolate drugs (methotrexate, pemetrexed) block ____.
Match the RECIPE letters of methotrexate DOC uses.
questions.exp: RECIPE: RA, ectopic pregnancy, choriocarcinoma, (I) immunosuppressant in GVHD (not DOC), (P) psoriatic arthritis, (E) excess dose in osteosarcoma, carcinomatous meningitis (Book p286)

questions.q: Methotrexate bone marrow suppression is prevented by ____.
Methotrexate crystals in urine are prevented by ____.
Long-term low-dose methotrexate causes liver ____.
questions.exp: Hepatotoxicity → liver cirrhosis (long term low dose) (Book p286)

questions.q: Pemetrexed is used for mesothelioma and ____.
questions.exp: Use: mesothelioma, non-small cell lung Ca (Book p286)

questions.q: Pemetrexed marrow suppression (P > M) is prevented by leucovorin + vitamin ____.
Lymphocytes have only the ____ purine pathway, so purine analogs hit them hardest (more useful in leukemia).
questions.exp: Lymphocyte: de-novo only → majorly affected → more useful in leukemia (Book p287)

questions.q: 6-mercaptopurine and 6-thioguanine are used for ____ ; S/E hepatotoxicity and marrow suppression.
With allopurinol, the 6MP dose is reduced by ____% (to prevent tumor lysis syndrome).
questions.exp: ↓ 75% dose of 6MP; to prevent tumor lysis syndrome (Book p287)

questions.q: Fludarabine is used in ____ and NHL.
Hairy cell leukemia DOC (rituximab added to regimen): ____.
questions.exp: Cladribine: hairy cell leukemia (DOC) (regimen: rituximab added) (Book p287)

questions.q: Pentostatin's MOA: blocks ____ ; alternative drug for hairy cell leukemia.
Clofarabine and nelarabine are used in resistant ____.
5-Fluorouracil inhibits ____ (T.S.).
5-Fluorouracil is given by ____ route.
Capecitabine is the oral prodrug of ____ ; regimen CapeOx.
Capecitabine (C > 5FU) causes hand and foot syndrome, prevented by vitamin ____.
questions.exp: Hand and foot syndrome (prevention: vit B6) (Book p287)

questions.q: Gemcitabine (pancreatic Ca) has the S/E ____.
Azacitidine and decitabine work by ____ of DNA; use: myelofibrosis.
questions.exp: MOA: demethylation of DNA; use myelofibrosis (Book p288)

questions.q: Myelofibrosis with 5q syndrome (anemia) is treated with ____.
questions.exp: Myelofibrosis with 5q syndrome (anemia) treatment: lenalidomide (Book p288)

questions.q: Cytarabine (Ara-C): AML; S/E ____ toxicity; route continuous IV infusion × 7 days.
questions.exp: S/E: cerebellar toxicity; continuous IV infusion × 7d (Book p288)

questions.q: Match the topoisomerase blocker to its use.
right: Testicular Ca, epithelial lung Ca (small or non-small cell)
questions.exp: Irinotecan colorectal/pancreatic; topotecan ovarian; etoposide testicular/epithelial lung; teniposide childhood ALL (Book p288)

questions.q: Irinotecan's characteristic S/E is ____ diarrhea, prevented by loperamide.
Match the histone deacetylase blocker to its use.
questions.exp: Vorinostat/romidepsin cutaneous T-cell lymphoma; belinostat peripheral T-cell lymphoma; panobinostat multiple myeloma (Book p288)

questions.q: HD blockers inhibit histone ____, preventing DNA rewinding after strand separation.
questions.exp: Blocks histone deacetylase → DNA rewinding blocked (Book p288)

questions.q: Hydroxyurea inhibits ____ reductase → ↓ deoxyribonucleotides → ↓ DNA synthesis.
Match the hydroxyurea use fact.
left: Sickle cell anemia, polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia
questions.exp: SPECiaL DOC: sickle cell anemia, polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia; CML listed; S/E leg ulcer (Book p288)

questions.q: Hydroxyurea's side effect is ____ ulcer.
Vinca alkaloids block β-tubulin → block microtubule ____, inhibiting CNS/PNS function.
questions.exp: Blocks microtubule polymerization → CNS/PNS function inhibited (Book p289)

questions.q: Match the vinca alkaloid to its use.
right: Children: ALL, NHL, neuroblastoma, Wilms tumor
questions.exp: Vincristine children's cancers; vinblastine Hodgkin's/testicular; vinorelbine NSCLC (Book p289)

questions.q: Vincristine's S/E are SIADH and maximum ____.
questions.exp: S/E: SIADH, peripheral neuropathy — maximum (Book p289)

questions.q: Taxanes stimulate β-tubulin → ↑ ____ of microtubules; uses GIT, breast, ovarian Ca.
Paclitaxel's hypersensitivity (m/c) is due to the ____ oil in its cremophor vehicle.
Nab-paclitaxel is water soluble; its m/c S/E is ____.

units.title: Antifolates
units.guide: 5FU+leucovorin → fdUMP → ternary complex on thymidylate synthase (dUMP→TMP). Antifolates block DHFR. MTX DOC RECIPE; S/E marrow (leucovorin), crystals (bicarbonate), cirrhosis (long-term low dose). Pemetrexed: mesothelioma/NSCLC; prevention leucovorin + B12.

units.title: Purine Analogs
units.guide: Inhibit de-novo pathway; lymphocytes (de-novo only) majorly affected → leukemia. 6MP/6TG ALL (hepato/marrow); +allopurinol ↓75% dose. Fludarabine CL/NHL. Cladribine hairy cell DOC (+rituximab). Pentostatin blocks adenosine deaminase. Clofarabine/nelarabine resistant ALL.

units.title: Pyrimidine Analogs
units.guide: 5FU inhibits T.S., IV, GIT/breast. Capecitabine oral prodrug (CapeOx), hand-foot (B6). Gemcitabine pancreatic, HUS. Azacitidine/decitabine demethylation → myelofibrosis; 5q syndrome → lenalidomide. Cytarabine AML, cerebellar toxicity, continuous IV ×7d.

units.title: Topoisomerase, HD Blockers and Hydroxyurea
units.sec: Topoisomerase, HD Blockers and Hydroxyurea · p288
units.guide: Topo-I: irinotecan (colorectal/pancreatic, delayed diarrhea→loperamide), topotecan (ovarian). Topo-II: etoposide (testicular/epithelial lung), teniposide (childhood ALL). HD blockers: vorinostat/romidepsin cutaneous T-cell, belinostat peripheral T-cell, panobinostat myeloma. Hydroxyurea: RDR inhibitor; SPECiaL DOC; leg ulcer.

units.title: Vinca Alkaloids
units.guide: Block β-tubulin → block microtubule polymerization → CNS/PNS inhibited. Vincristine children (ALL/NHL/neuroblastoma/Wilms), SIADH + max neuropathy. Vinblastine Hodgkin's/testicular. Vinorelbine NSCLC.

units.title: Taxanes and Other M-Phase Drugs
units.sec: Taxanes and Other M-Phase Drugs · p289
units.guide: Taxanes stimulate β-tubulin → ↑ polymerization; GIT/breast/ovarian. Paclitaxel cremophor (ethanol+castor oil) → hypersensitivity (castor oil). Nab-paclitaxel water soluble, neuropathy m/c. Docetaxel polysorbate 80 → H2O retention/edema/CHF. Ixabepilone & eribulin breast; estramustine prostate, gynecomastia.
